segments.text: When war was declared on India's behalf without consulting the Congress leadership, Bose organized mass protests in Kolkata.
He called for the Holwell monument standing at Dalhousie Square to be removed as a symbol of colonial oppression.
Bose was thrown into jail by the British authorities but was released following a courageous 7-day hunger strike.
Following his release, Bose's ancestral house in Kolkata was placed under strict 24-hour surveillance by the British CID.
